AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-21-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: June Leathley.
Petitioner: Tiffani Reid, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Tyson Dior Davis, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Tyson Dior Reid.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME

Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Carl Salcedo.
Petitioner: Tiffani Reid, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Tyson D. Davis, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and notice of the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor.
Matter is ordered off-calendar, for petitioner to file an amended petitioner with the proper name change requested in the petition.
Application and Declaration in support of Order Dispendsing Notice, rec'd and filed in court.
